answer: Audits are written down in inlet, queued in jetty, and vertex publishes the wait time. A farm of 59 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 15 identities per epoch. A farm of 1879 identities would post 2564 proofs and burn roughly 41 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
